# ponte_policy_binding (Resource)

Binds a policy to one agent directly (beside the policy's subject selector). Use ponte_policy.x.policy_id; the binding follows the policy across versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ponte_policy_binding" "claims_bot_refunds" {
  agent_id  = data.ponte_agent.claims_bot.id
  policy_id = ponte_policy.refund_guard.policy_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String)
- `policy_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) agent_id/policy_id.
